rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something physically curving or twisting, especially a road, path, or line.

example.english: This winding mountain road requires you to drive slowly.
example.traditional: 呢條山路彎彎曲曲，揸車要慢啲。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 saan1 lou6 waan1 waan1 kuk1 kuk1 zaa1 ce1 jiu3 maan6 di1

rows.note: Use this for speech or writing that expresses something indirectly instead of getting to the point.

example.english: His winding explanation never gets to the point.
example.traditional: 佢講嘢成日拐彎抹角，唔肯直接講重點。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 je5 seng4 jat6 gwaai2 waan1 mut3 gok3 m4 hang2 zik6 zip3 gong2 zung6 dim2

rows.note: Use this when someone keeps rambling or avoids the point in conversation, rather than merely phrasing something indirectly.

example.english: Stop winding around the subject and just say what you mean.
example.traditional: 你唔好再兜圈子啦，有咩事就直接講。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 dau1 hyun1 zi2 laa1 jau5 me1 si6 zau6 zik6 zip3 gong2
